'''Tam-Lee''' was a wind spirit in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology who carried the sounds of Ewok horns to hunters, guiding them home. "Tam-Lee" was a popular name given to female Ewoks.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tam-Lee was first mentioned in the roleplaying game ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'' in [[2003]].<ref name="GCG" />
